knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Substitution with a product that does not need mixing removes the mixing hazard at source. PPE is the lowest-ranked option and a written procedure is administrative.
A residual score that counts a control assumes the control works. A control the crew has never seen is not in place, so it must not be counted.
A residual score that does not improve shows the controls have not worked. The task waits until the controls are redefined and re-assessed.

practicalCriteria: Lists at least three candidate controls for a named hazard before choosing
Ranks the candidates and labels each by type
Writes each chosen control as an action with an owner
Re-scores residual risk and gives a reason tied to a verified control
passRule: Knowledge checks are a reading check only and are not verified practical competence. Assessor must observe every practical criterion; any failure requires remediation and reassessment.
stopWorkCriteria: A safety feature is removed or bypassed to speed up work
The learner lowers a residual score for a control that has not been checked
